$comment: Schema 1 of the catalogue. Every value in SI units, given in each number's "unit"; an empty CSV field is a value the source does not give.
title: linear_guide
description: A profile rail guide: one size and carriage type.

part_number.description: The maker's part number (order number), as printed.

dynamic_load_rating_n.description: C as printed, for the travel in dynamic_load_rating_distance_m.

carriage_type.description: The maker's carriage type as printed (flange, square, long ...).

seal_drag_n.description: Friction of the carriage's standard end seals alone, per carriage.

height_m.description: Height from the bottom of the rail to the top of the carriage.

dynamic_load_rating_distance_m.description: The travel the maker gives dynamic_load_rating_n for: 50 km (50000) or 100 km (100000) as printed. The life in that distance is reached by 90 % of guides at a load equal to C.

source.description: The id of the row's source in the table's metadata; without it, the metadata's default_source.
